gloss: Murasaki Shikibu (author of The Tale of Genji)

definitions.gloss: Murasaki Shikibu, Heian court lady and author of The Tale of Genji
definitions.explanation: The writer, active around the year 1000, who served at the imperial court and wrote {源氏物語|げんじものがたり}, often called the world's first novel. She also left a diary of court life.

examples.japanese: {紫式部|むらさきしきぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平安時代|へいあんじだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧だ。
examples.english: Murasaki Shikibu was a writer of the Heian period.

examples.japanese: {源氏物語|げんじものがたり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{紫式部|むらさきしきぶ}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{書|か}かれた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The Tale of Genji was written by Murasaki Shikibu.

examples.japanese: {紫式部|むらさきしきぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{宮中|きゅうちゅう}→宮中：12653_kyuuchuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{記|しる}されている→記す：14238_shirusu⟧。
examples.english: What Murasaki Shikibu saw of the people at court is also recorded in detail in her diary.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {紫式部|むらさきしきぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{源氏物語|げんじものがたり}: Murasaki Shikibu's Tale of Genji
- {紫式部|むらさきしきぶ}⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧: The Diary of Lady Murasaki
- {清少納言|せいしょうなごん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{紫式部|むらさきしきぶ}: Sei Shonagon and Murasaki Shikibu, the paired names of Heian women's writing

CULTURAL NOTE:
Every Japanese student meets her in school, so the name stands for classical literature and for female authorship generally. Neither ⟦{紫|むらさき}→紫：00297_murasaki⟧ nor {式部|しきぶ} is a real personal name: {式部|しきぶ} refers to her father's court post and ⟦{紫|むらさき}→紫：00297_murasaki⟧ to a character in her own novel.

The same word also names a shrub, {紫式部|むらさきしきぶ} (Japanese beautyberry), whose purple berries were felt to suit her.
